Shovelhook is an aggressive hard rock band native to Philadelphia, whose lineup include 3 blood brothers. Their self-released album, Blood Royal, mixed by Grammy Award winning Producer/Engineer Phil Nicolo, has sold over 3,000 copies since its release in November 2005. The band attracted the attention of Philadelphia's premier rock station, 93.3 WMMR-FM, and their single, "So Sorry" was added to regular rotation for three months, following a storm of requests by listeners.
